ers.strip.off: Engine off. Nothing will be sent.
ers.strip.off.detail: Sending stays blocked until the safety checks pass.
ers.strip.settings_note: Turn the engine on or off in Settings, Sending.
ers.hold.ENGINE_OFF: The engine is off, so this will not send.
ers.hold.ENGINE_OFF.release: It sends after the engine is switched on and the safety checks pass.
ers.hold.APPROVAL_PENDING.release: It sends after a person approves it.
ers.hold.CONTACT_LOCK: Active conversation. The contact owner decides when to resume.
ers.hold.CONTACT_LOCK.release: The contact owner or an admin can resume it.
ers.hold.ACCOUNT_LOCK: Another contact at {company} is in a conversation.
ers.hold.ACCOUNT_LOCK.release: It resumes when that conversation ends.
ers.hold.OPP_ACTIVE: Open deal at {stage}. General follow-ups are paused.
ers.hold.OPP_ACTIVE.release: It resumes if the deal closes or moves on.
ers.hold.FREQUENCY_CAP.release: It sends on its own after that date.
ers.hold.IDENTITY_HEALTH: Sender {name} is {state}. Waiting for it to recover.
ers.hold.IDENTITY_HEALTH.release: It sends when the sender is healthy again.
ers.hold.IDENTITY_LIMIT.release: It sends when the limit resets.
ers.hold.SUPPRESSED: Suppressed ({reason}). This contact will not be emailed.
ers.hold.LINT_BLOCK: The copy check blocked this email. Edit the template to continue.
ers.hold.LINT_BLOCK.release: It sends after the template passes the copy check.
ers.hold.DEAD_LETTER: Failed after {n} attempts. Needs a decision.
ers.hold.DEAD_LETTER.release: A person chooses to retry or stop it.
ers.hold.KILL_SWITCH.release: It resumes after the switch is released.
ers.hold.UNCONFIRMED: The mail server’s answer is unclear. Check before sending again.
ers.hold.UNCONFIRMED.release: Check the sent record first. Resend only if it did not go out.
ers.hold.resume_blocked: Resume is not available: a complaint, opt-out, do-not-contact or legal block applies.
ers.hold.scope_note: Only the contact owner or an admin can enroll or resume.
ers.gate.engine_switch.name: Engine switch
ers.gate.engine_switch.unmet: The engine is off. Switch it on in Settings, Sending.
ers.gate.safety_suite.name: Sending safety tests
ers.gate.safety_suite.unmet: The sending safety tests have not passed yet.
ers.gate.feedback.name: Bounce, complaint and opt-out handling
ers.gate.feedback.met: Bounces, complaints and opt-outs are being processed.
ers.gate.feedback.unmet: Bounce, complaint and opt-out handling is not live yet.
ers.gate.sender_health.name: Sender health
ers.gate.allowlist.name: Launch allowlist
ers.gate.allowlist.met: Only {n} approved addresses can receive email.
ers.gate.allowlist.unmet: No allowlist is set. Set one before sending.
ers.gate.simulation.name: Simulation reviewed
ers.gate.simulation.unmet: No reviewed simulation for this version. Run one and approve it.
ers.gate.copy_check.name: Copy check
ers.gate.copy_check.unmet: {n} blocking flags. Fix them in the Library.
ers.gate.stepup.name: Admin verification
ers.gate.stepup.status: You will be asked for your password when you confirm.
ers.gate.simulation.stale: This simulation is out of date. Run it again.
ers.gate.dialog.title: Activate {sequence} (v{version})
ers.gate.dialog.intro: Starting this sequence lets the engine send emails to enrolled contacts.
ers.gate.dialog.heading: Safety checks
ers.gate.dialog.unmet_lead: This sequence can’t be activated yet.
ers.gate.dialog.unmet_count: {n} safety checks are not met. You can keep it Ready. It will only start after they pass.
ers.gate.dialog.approval_mode: Once the safety checks pass, emails in AUTO steps send automatically on schedule. Steps switched to REQUIRED wait for approval in My Work.
ers.gate.dialog.approval_mode.all_requir: Every step needs review, so activating will not send anything by itself. Each email waits for approval in My Work.
ers.gate.dialog.approval_mode.all_auto: Once the safety checks pass, every email in this sequence sends automatically on schedule. Nothing waits for approval unless the copy check holds it for review.
ers.gate.dialog.changed: A safety check changed while this was open.
ers.gate.pause_confirm: Pause {sequence}? Contacts stay enrolled. Nothing more is sent until it is resumed.
ers.gate.ready_banner: Draft created from {name}. Copy is imported exactly. Edit the template in the Library, not here.
ers.empty.sequences: No sequences yet. Start from a prebuilt sequence.
ers.empty.approvals: No emails are waiting for approval.
ers.approvals.description: This queue shows emails in REQUIRED steps and emails the copy check has held for review. Emails in AUTO steps send on schedule and do not appear here.
ers.empty.library: No templates yet. An admin can import the library.
ers.empty.simulate: No simulation yet. Run one to see what would happen. Nothing is sent.
ers.sim.hard_rule: Simulation never sends. It can’t change counters or enrollments.
ers.sim.setup_note: No emails are sent. No counters change.
ers.sim.tip.SEND: This email is ready and would go out at its scheduled time.
ers.sim.tip.REVIEW: A person approves this email first. Nothing goes out until they do.
ers.sim.tip.HOLD: Something is in the way, such as a limit or an open conversation. It would wait and send later if it clears.
ers.sim.tip.BLOCK: A firm rule applies, such as a suppression or a copy-check block. It would not send until that is fixed.
ers.sim.approve_note: Approving records that an admin reviewed this exact simulation. It does not send anything.
ers.skeleton.disabled_reason: This is a skeleton. The copy is not written yet, so it can’t be simulated, sent or activated.
ers.persona.note: Signed “Rhonda” (persona). Sent from ICS Sales Team.
ers.approval.auto.label: Automatic sending · no per-email approval
ers.approval.required.label: Approval required · each email waits for review
ers.approval.contract_note.details: The contract recommends REQUIRED approval for this program.
ers.campaign.manual_reply.stops: Stop requests are handled by the campaign owner.
ers.hold.REPLY_REVIEW: Waiting for the owner to review replies.
ers.hold.REPLY_REVIEW.release: The campaign owner reviews the reply, then releases or stops the follow-up.
ers.action.release_followup.confirm: Release the next follow-up for {contact}? It will send on its normal schedule.
ers.state.content.label: Content readiness
ers.state.content.draft.tip: The copy is still being written.
ers.state.content.needs_evidence.tip: Claims or facts in this copy need supporting evidence before it can be used.
ers.state.content.prepared.tip: The copy is ready to be reviewed for a campaign.
ers.state.review.label: Campaign review
ers.state.review.reviewed: Reviewed · bound to this audience and content
ers.state.review.stale: Review out of date · the audience or content changed. Review again.
ers.state.ops.label: Operational readiness
ers.state.ops.detail: Sender health, limits, allowlist and safety checks. Shown separately from the copy and the review.
ers.bucket.held.tip: Stopped by a rule or a person. See the reason.
ers.bucket.sending.tip: Being handed to the mail server now.
ers.bucket.submitted.tip: Handed to the mail server. Delivery is not confirmed here.
ers.bucket.failed.tip: The mail server rejected it, or it failed after retries.
ers.bucket.uncertain.tip: The mail server’s answer is unclear. Check before sending again.
ers.metric.overlap_note: These counts can overlap. One contact can reply and also ask to stop.
ers.action.schedule_blast.confirm: Schedule {n} emails to start on {when}? Nothing sends until the safety checks pass.
ers.pause.title: Pause this campaign?
ers.pause.body: {pending} emails not yet submitted stay pending and will not send until you resume. {submitted} emails already submitted to the mail server cannot be recalled.
ers.cancel.title: Cancel this campaign?
ers.cancel.body: {pending} emails not yet submitted will be canceled. {submitted} emails already submitted to the mail server cannot be recalled.
